label: fmf-11-13-v1
description: FMF competing-risks model for preeclampsia at 11-13 weeks, transcribed from published papers. NOT the FMF website algorithm.

verification_levels.verified: Transcribed and checked by a second person against the printed paper.
verification_levels.transcribed: Transcribed from the paper by one person; needs a second-person check before clinical use.
verification_levels.transcribed_signs_inferred: Numbers transcribed; one or more signs inferred from confidence intervals or text because the source extraction lost minus signs. Must be checked against the printed table.
verification_levels.missing: Not available in any source we could access. The component is disabled until filled.

prior.source: Wright D, Syngelaki A, Akolekar R, Poon LC, Nicolaides KH. Am J Obstet Gynecol 2015;213:62.e1-10, Table 2. doi:10.1016/j.ajog.2015.02.018
notes: Mean gestational age (weeks) at delivery with PE; Gaussian with fixed SD.
Signs inferred from 95% CIs: e.g. chronic hypertension CI -7.87 to -6.71 is stated as -7.3 in the text.

Interval powers read as interval^-1 and interval^-0.5 (fractional polynomial); positive powers give implausible results and contradict the paper's text that the protective effect falls with longer intervals.
Reference group: White, nulliparous, spontaneous conception, weight 69 kg, height 164 cm, no medical or family history. East Asian has no separate term in this model.

implementation_choices.why: The fractional polynomial diverges as the interval approaches zero; the paper does not say how FMF bounds it. Needs validation against the FMF calculator.

mom.source: Tan MY et al. Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2018;52:186-195, Appendix 1 (formulas for MoM at 11-13 weeks). doi:10.1002/uog.19112. The appendix states these are default parameters whose suitability should be checked before use.
notes: Each model gives log10 of the expected median; MoM = observed / 10^(expected).
ga = gestational age in days minus 77. Weight in kg minus 69, height in cm minus 164, age in years minus 35.
Diabetes type 2 not treated with insulin has no PlGF term in the appendix.

likelihood.source: O'Gorman N et al. Am J Obstet Gynecol 2016;214:103.e1-12, doi:10.1016/j.ajog.2015.08.034 (and Tan 2018). Tables are behind a subscription and could not be read.
notes: Needed: for each biomarker, the line relating mean log10 MoM in PE to gestational age at delivery, the gestational age where it meets the unaffected mean, and the SDs and correlations of log10 MoM.
Until filled, the engine reports risk from maternal factors only and refuses biomarker-combined risks.

truncation.source: Chaemsaithong P et al. Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2020;56:206-214 (0.4 to 2.5 MoM used as truncation limits). doi:10.1002/uog.21905. FMF's own limits per marker are not confirmed.

dating.source: Robinson HP, Fleming JE. Br J Obstet Gynaecol 1975;82:702-710. GA (days) = 8.052 * sqrt(CRL mm) + 23.73.
